messages:
Dana Liu: Flagging the postmortem follow-up for the vendor/auth+registry outage. Need clear owners, dates, and accept criteria.
Omar Haddad: I'll take the cross-cloud failover checklist and infra retry defaults. ETA 5 business days.
Priya Mehta: I'll handle model-registry client resilience (exponential backoff, idempotency keys) and add integration tests. ETA 12 days.
Roberto Alvarez: I'll lead vendor escalation + single-pane vendor contact sheet and legal ask for improved SLAs. ETA 6 days.
Dana Liu: Please add acceptance criteria here so we can close items in the ticket.
Omar Haddad: Acceptance for infra: 1) failover exercise completes in <45s when simulating region loss 2) proxy default retries = 4 with jitter, 3) metric infra.failover.exercises emitted.
Priya Mehta: Registry criteria: 1) client retries maintain p95 latency <300ms under 2x baseline load 2) idempotent retry tests pass 3) canary with 3% fault injection holds >=99.5% success. Issue: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/issues/4799
Roberto Alvarez: Vendor ask: dedicated escalation channel + 4hr response SLA for auth/registry; request weekly incident summary for 2 months. Will add contact spreadsheet and phone escalation tree.
incident-bot: Created follow-up ticket: INC-FOLLOWUP-2371234567. Linked to main postmortem.
Dana Liu: Also need token rotation audit — we saw ~1% expired tokens during the incident. Who can pick this up?
Omar Haddad: I'll add token rotation audit job to infra. ETA 3 days. Will trigger alert if >0.25% tokens expire without refresh in 24h.
Priya Mehta: Adding a verification playbook (6 steps) for on-call to run post-mitigation: includes curl health checks, grafana checks, and a smoke request with tracing headers.
Roberto Alvarez: Scheduling a 60-day follow-up and a quarterly recurrence review. Calendar invites sent to Eng, SRE, SecOps, and Product.
Dana Liu: Good. Action owners: Omar (infra+token audit), Priya (registry), Roberto (vendor+SLA). Please update INC-FOLLOWUP-2371234567 with ETAs and acceptance criteria by EOD tomorrow.
Omar Haddad: Will do. Opening PRs for retry defaults tomorrow morning.
Priya Mehta: Starting test work after standup.
Roberto Alvarez: Drafting vendor outreach and looping Legal.
incident-bot: Reminder: follow-up check-in scheduled on 2026-07-10 15:00 UTC.
